title: Gaussian generator under noise
statement: Let $n\ge0$, let $f,g:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$, and suppose $g$ is the Gaussian generator of $f$. For every $\rho\in[-1,1]$, the Gaussian noise averages of $f$ and $g$ with parameter $\rho$ have the same generator relation: the noise average of $g$ is a Gaussian generator of the noise average of $f$.
